# Method SetSilentMode

#### SetSilentMode(bool)

Sets the silent mode.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 15, 400, 100)]
void SetSilentMode(bool inIsSilent)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  bool |  inIsSilent |  Tells wether the silent mode is activated.  |
